content:
Context: - OM, dated 6-4-201'8.

In case any beneficiary becomes ineligible for availing CGHS facilities, it shall be the responsibility of the main cardholder to inform the Additional Director / CMO i/c either through the Department or directly, failing which benefits will be withdrawn in addition to other action by appropriate authority. Department will be responsible for retaining and getting deleted from the database the employees transferred to non-CGHS area / organizations or on resignation / retirement. - OM, dated 10-2-2021.
